title: Customer Service Agent: Digital Assistant
lede: Use an enterprise-controlled assistant to find cheap flights while keeping customer data, delegated authority, and high-impact actions bounded.

steps.title: 1. Assign the task
steps.what: The app records the assistant, customer relationship, destination, price ceiling, and schedule. (register)

steps.title: 2. Prove identities
steps.what: The customer and workload identity remain distinct in the delegated chain. (authenticate)

steps.title: 3. Search within mandate
steps.what: Read-only flight searches are permitted under the declared task. (authorize)

steps.title: 4. Escalate booking
steps.what: A purchase cannot proceed on the assistant’s preference alone. (authorize)

steps.title: 5. Record outcome
steps.what: Approval, booking result, and agent identity share one evidence chain. (govern)
